THIS MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS APPEAL HAVING BEEN FINALLY HEARD ON 07.08.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 2025:KER:61203 MACA NO. 1931 OF 2014  3  JUDGMENT

This appeal is filed by the appellant/2nd respondent - owner in O.P(MV) No.329 of 2010 on the file of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Kalpetta, granting the insurance company the right to recover the award amount from the owner.
The respondents herein are the claimant and respondents 1 and 3 before the Tribunal.

2. According to the claimant, on 06.01.2010, at about 8.30 a.m., she was hit by a bus bearing registration No.KL-12D/1727 due to the rash and negligent driving of the first respondent while she was standing at the side of the public road at Ammayipalam, whereby she sustained serious injuries.
The claimant approached the Tribunal claiming a total compensation of 8,69,000/-, which is limited to 8,00,000/-.
3. The first, second and third respondents were the driver, owner and the insurer of the offending vehicle respectively.
Though notice was served on the respondents, the first and 2025:KER:61203 MACA NO. 1931 OF 2014 second respondents remained absent and were set ex parte before the Tribunal.

The third respondent - insurer filed a written statement admitting the insurance policy,
disputing the liability and the quantum of compensation claimed.
They further contended that the first respondent was not having a valid driving licence at the time of accident.
Since there was violation of policy conditions, they sought for exoneration of liability.
Exts.A1 to A9 and Ext.C1 were marked before the Tribunal.

The Tribunal, after analysing the pleadings and materials on record,
found that the 3rd respondent being the insurer is liable to pay the compensation amount and awarded a sum of 75,480/- as compensation under different heads with interest @ 7.5% per annum from the date of petition till realization and recover the same from the 1 st and 2nd respondents.

The third respondent - insurer is granted recovery right from the second respondent - Latheef vs Chandrika on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29437206/
2 the owner of the offending vehicle.

sentences.text: Challenging the right of recovery ordered against the owner, the appellant has come up in appeal.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the appellant - owner and the learned standing counsel appearing for the insurer and the learned counsel appearing for the claimant.
5. The learned counsel for the appellant submitted that though notice was served, he could not appear before the Tribunal since he was working abroad.
The vehicle was also sold.
He came to know about the disposal of the case only when the insurance company initiated execution proceedings and a recovery notice was served on the appellant.

The appellant produced before this Court the original licence, along with I.A. No. 2/2025, and submits that the driver of the vehicle was having a valid driving licence for driving the transport vehicle while the accident occured on 06.01.2010.
The driving licence was valid from 05.09.2003 to 27.05.2027 and argued that the direction granting the insurance company the right to recover the amount from the owner, is unsustainable.

6. The learned standing counsel appearing for the 2025:KER:61203 MACA NO. 1931 OF 2014 insurance company, on the other hand, submits that after producing the original licence along with I.A.No.2/2025, they sought information under the R.T.I. Act, a copy of which was produced before this Court on 07.08.2025.
The learned standing counsel further submits that there was no valid driving licence for the driver to drive the bus at the time of the accident.

He also relied on the information provided by the Senior Superintendent, Regional Transport Office, Wayanad, in response to the querry whether the driver of the offending vehicle, Mr. Shiju C.P., was authorized to drive the bus or a Class IV vehicle on 06.01.2020, the date of the accident.
The answer given to the said question was "no."
It was stated that there was a gap period from 19.05.2009 to 27.05.2022.

The original of the driving licence now produced before this Court along with I.A.No.2/2025, it is stated that the driver was having a valid driving licence which was issued on 05.09.2003 and the validity noted in the driving licence is upto 27.05.2027, which covers the date of accident as well.

It is true 2025:KER:61203 MACA NO. 1931 OF 2014 that the appellant has produced the original of the driving licence as well as the insurance company has also received information through R.T.I.,
that there was no valid driving licence at the time of accident.
In order to arrive at a just decision, I find that the matter needs to be remanded back to the Tribunal by affording the parties an opportunity to raise their contentions.
The Tribunal need not re-visit the quantum of compensation already awarded by the Tribunal, since the claimant has not challenged the quantum of compensation awarded.
The amount awarded was already paid by the insurance company to the claimant.
Accordingly, the appeal is disposed of as follows.

The award dated 19.12.2012 passed by the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Kalpetta, to the extent of granting the right of recovery to the insurer to Latheef vs Chandrika on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29437206/
3 recover the amount from the appellant herein - the owner, alone is set aside.

sentences.text: The Tribunal is directed to reconsider the question whether the insurer, or the 2025:KER:61203 MACA NO. 1931 OF 2014 owner or the driver is liable to pay the amount awarded.
The parties shall be at liberty to tender fresh evidence or produce additional documents if any, in order to prove their contentions regarding the liability alone.
The Tribunal shall afford adequate opportunities to the parties in this case.
The Tribunal shall reconsider the afore issue regarding liability and pass appropriate orders, in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible.
Registry is directed to return the original licence produced before this Court along with I.A.No.2/2025, to the appellant - owner.
The parties are directed to appear before the Tribunal on 09.09.2025.
